text: Iteration 33 (cloud session): build SimForge v6 (sensor model w/ physical units, multi-resonance transmission path, non-Gaussian burst noise, per-impact bearing slip jitter, in-record speed ramps, load-varying VFD lines), regenerate corpus features at deployment condition, retrain fault/severity heads, and evaluate BLIND end-to-end on GitHub-reachable real data (CWRU, MFPT, SEU, wind turbine) against frozen v5 and a classical baseline B1 (kurtogram+envelope at nameplate speed). MAFAULDA remains local-session priority one.

Sim-vs-real discriminator (windowed fs-invariant spectral/envelope features, GBM, healthy-vs-healthy): AUC(v6 vs real) <= AUC(v5 vs real) - 0.05 absolute, on the same real windows. Verdict from experiments/simgap/findings.json only.

Blind end-to-end (analyze_record only, no oracle speed anywhere): v6-trained cascade bearing recall on CWRU+MFPT dev-real >= v5 cascade, AND false bearing calls on healthy/normal records <= v5. Wilson 95% CIs reported; N<30 auto-labeled ANECDOTE.

Classical baseline B1 (SK/kurtogram band selection + envelope spectrum peak test at nameplate-derived defect orders, noise-floor significance) implemented with matched false-positive gate and run on the same dev-real records. The v5-vs-B1 and v6-vs-B1 comparisons are reported whichever way they fall.

detail: auc_v2_vs_real 0.991, auc_v6_vs_real 0.982, delta 0.009 < required 0.05. Neither in 0.5-0.8 realism band. Attribution moved from psd_crest (v2) to peak_density + band_22 + env_flatness (v6): real records have denser spectral peak content and different HF band energy than both generators. Next-gen fix list is evidence-ranked, not taste-ranked.
caveat: n_real=24 windows/15 records (small but grouped-CV AUC ~0.99 is decisive)

detail: BLIND end-to-end, no oracle speed: CWRU bearing recall v6 0.967 (CI 0.886-0.991) vs v5 0.717 (CI 0.592-0.815); MFPT 17/17 both; false positives improved everywhere (CWRU normals 2/4 vs 3/4, MFPT baselines 0/3 vs 2/3, SEU healthy 3/4 vs 4/4). Realism-trained models transfer better while their synthetic self-score HALVED (OOF macro-F1 0.506 vs ~0.8): simulator ease was inflating self-assessment and hurting transfer.

B1 classical: CWRU detection 1.0 (CI 0.94-1.0), subtype-given-detection 0.633, 3/4 normal FP; MFPT 17/17 det + 17/17 subtype, 2/3 baseline FP; WT trend alarm day 11 vs Phase-2 cascade day 31. Comparison: v5 blind LOSES to B1 on CWRU detection (0.717 vs 1.0); v6 blind is statistically indistinguishable from B1 on CWRU detection (0.967, overlapping CIs) with fewer FPs (2/4 vs 3/4, ANECDOTE n) and adds 6-way classification+severity. SEU stays broken for the cascade (1/16). B1 remains ahead on run-to-failure early warning (day 11 vs 31, single sequence).
